description: Java class FtlWriter that processes FreeMarker template language (FTL) templates and writes output to Appendables. It manages template environments, processes RenderableFtl objects, and handles macro calls, string templates, and no-ops within the FreeMarker templating framework.

classes.name: FtlWriter
classes.description: Final class that handles processing of FreeMarker templates and strings, manages environments, and processes RenderableFtl objects via an internal visitor class.

methods.name: FtlWriter
methods.description: Constructor that loads a macro library template and initializes with a VisualTheme.

methods.name: processFtl
methods.description: Processes a RenderableFtl object, rendering it via a visitor pattern and writing to the provided Appendable.

methods.name: processFtlString
methods.description: Processes an FTL string as a template with a given locale and writes the result to the Appendable.

methods.name: getEnvironment
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a FreeMarker Environment for the given Appendable and locale, associated with the macro library template.
